steps.name: Click getByTestId('menu-item-card').filter({ hasText: 'Automation Burger' }).or(getByRole('heading', { name: 'Automation Burger', exact: true })).first()
Fill "Fee" getByRole('heading', { name: 'Customer Information' }).locator('..').getByRole('textbox', { name: /first name/i }).first()
Fill "Lima" getByRole('heading', { name: 'Customer Information' }).locator('..').getByRole('textbox', { name: /last name/i }).first()
finalize-surcharge must succeed — the card is checked before it is charged
Fee removed: the lower total is shown, then a second tap pays it
Expect "toBeVisible" getByText(/(?:not|n't) charged the processing fee/i)
